primary_gt.mechanism_question: compare coastal water-level, pressure, wave, rainfall, and exposure evidence to identify the dominant flood forcing
primary_gt.decisive_evidence: Coastal water-level and wave evidence should dominate unless rainfall-runoff metrics clearly overturn the coastal mechanism.
primary_gt.rejected_simplifications: Reject rainfall-only, wind-only, or exposure-only explanations if they cannot explain the coastal flooding signature.
primary_gt.bounded_interpretation: The result is not a tide-gauge reconstruction, property-loss model, or building-level flood map.

key_values.event_name: Hurricane Sandy New York-New Jersey coastal flooding

judge_anchors.canonical_stance: The ledger supports surge and wave coastal flooding as primary for Hurricane Sandy in the New York-New Jersey area.
required_metrics: 174.0 h over a 240 h event window, ratio 0.725
45.4 mm event precipitation and 0.824 wettest-24-hour fraction
0.362 local/catalog wind ratio and 0.033 high-wind-hour fraction
71.07 mm grid mean consensus and 72.445 mm product spread
forbidden_claims: A generic cyclone label is as specific as the computed coastal flooding label.

criteria.name: mechanism_diagnosis
criteria.description: Identifies the dominant physical process and gives the correct compact answer label or an equivalent diagnosis.

criteria.name: computed_evidence
criteria.description: Recomputes the quantitative evidence inherited from the original task and preserves units, signs, ratios, and key values.

criteria.name: evidence_weighting
criteria.description: Explains which evidence streams are decisive and which are contextual or weaker proxies.

criteria.name: counterfactual_rejection
criteria.description: Rejects at least one tempting simplified explanation using the computed values rather than assertion.

criteria.name: bounded_interpretation
criteria.description: States scale, timing, proxy, or uncertainty limits without adding unsupported losses or impacts.

criteria.name: json_contract
criteria.description: Returns the requested structured mechanism-diagnosis JSON without reducing the answer to a row-only table or same-scale checklist.
